title: User asking for SMS and WhatsApp (must refuse that part)

answers.q3_details: Client name, phone, service, date, notes, preferred stylist
answers.q7_contributor_alert: Yes, and text me on WhatsApp whenever she adds something.
answers.q8_follow_up: Yes, send my clients an SMS reminder 1 day before their appointment.
answers.q9_weekly_digest: Yes, Monday morning at 9, and also send it to my WhatsApp.

expected.notes: Email alert and email digest are supported, so they are kept as email. WhatsApp and SMS are impossible and must be omitted from the plan and listed in unsupported_requests. Client-facing SMS reminders are also unsupported. The plan may still include an owner-facing follow_up_due email reminder only if there is a date field to anchor it; the diff does NOT require one (follow_up_reminder_days null), and also does not penalize it. The plan must contain no phone-based notify targets.
